offers.name: Apple Education Store
offers.perk: Education pricing on Mac, iPad and other Apple products
offers.details: Sold through Apple's Philippine Education Store. Eligibility is verified through UNiDAYS before checkout. Apple Music and Apple TV student pricing may also be listed there.
offers.requirements: Verified higher-education student, parent buying for a student, or educator
offers.caveats: Apple limits how many discounted items you can buy per year. Promos such as gift-card offers are time-limited, so check the store for current ones.

offers.name: Philippine Airlines student discount
offers.details: Under the Student Fare Discount Act, the discount applies while the student is enrolled. If PAL has a CAB-approved promo fare, you can choose between the promo fare and the regular fare minus the discount. Third-party sources report 20% off base fares on domestic flights.
offers.requirements: Proof of enrollment, usually presented when buying the ticket
offers.caveats: Reportedly excludes some low fare classes, promo fares, international routes and postgraduate or short courses. Check PAL's student discount page for the current rules.

offers.name: PAL Global Student Plus
offers.perk: Discounted fares for international students aged 12 to 31
offers.details: A PAL program for students travelling abroad to study. Reported at around 10%.
offers.requirements: Age 12 to 31, enrolled or accepted at an overseas school
offers.caveats: Terms may have changed since the 2023 announcement. Confirm on PAL's site.

offers.name: Spotify Premium Student
offers.details: The Philippines is a supported country. Verification goes through SheerID.
offers.requirements: Enrolled at an accredited higher-education institution
offers.caveats: Must re-verify every 12 months, up to four years. Prices change, so none are listed here.

offers.name: YouTube Premium Student
offers.perk: Discounted YouTube Premium plan for students
offers.details: Student pricing has been extended to the Philippines.
offers.caveats: Prices have changed before, so none are listed here.

offers.name: Microsoft education offers
offers.perk: Free Office 365 Education with a school email, and possible student discounts on devices
offers.details: Microsoft offers Office 365 Education to eligible schools' students and staff. Device discounts and Microsoft 365 Personal student pricing vary by country.
offers.requirements: A school email address from an eligible institution
offers.caveats: Philippines-specific terms were not confirmed. Availability depends on your school. Check your local Microsoft Store page.

offers.name: LRT-1, LRT-2 and MRT-3 student fare
offers.perk: 50% student discount on Metro Manila rail
offers.details: DOTr raised the student discount from 20% to 50% in June 2025, and it is meant to run until 2028. Show your student ID at any station counter to get a student Beep card.
offers.caveats: Since March 23, 2026, MRT-3 and LRT-2 also give 50% off to everyone with a blue Beep card until further notice, so the student perk may add nothing there right now. Verified from news reports only, not official sites.

offers.name: Student Fare Discount Act (RA 11314)
offers.perk: 20% student fare discount on public transport
offers.details: The law covers public transport including jeepneys, buses, taxis, trains, airlines and ships. Show a valid school ID.
offers.requirements: Valid school ID or proof of enrollment
offers.caveats: Charter, school-service and shuttle arrangements are excluded. Rail lines now have their own higher discount. Enforcement varies.
